remarks: Nestled in the quaint Mid-Ridges neighborhood of Stamford, this .61 acre property offers a rare opportunity. Overlooking a serene lake on a quiet cul-de-sac, this suburban haven is close to downtown Stamford amenities and just a short commute to New York City, making it ideal for those seeking a balance of tranquility without sacrificing urban convenience. Embrace the potential of this prime piece of real estate. With picturesque views and serene surroundings, this plot is a blank canvas awaiting your vision. Build your dream home in a coveted location surround by nature yet close to the vibrant city of Stamford. Experience the incredible close-by amenities of Stamford Downtown with a bustling hub of dining, shopping, entertainment and a vibrant cultural scene. Nearby Stamford Museum & Nature Center and Cove Island Park enjoy educational exhibits and scenic trails. Medical parks for easy access to healthcare, various recreational facilities, multiple public transportation options make this central location an incredible place to live. Buyer to do own due-diligence. Offered as-is. Plans are approximate proposals and subject to change. No representations or guarantees
